title: CLT with TLC
body: You are a super fan of the girl group TLC! However, you are not sure how many of your friends have heard of TLC. You want to estimate the population proportion of UC Berkeley students who know of TLC using a 95% confidence interval. Before you choose a sample size and go out to take your sample, you decide that you want the width of your confidence interval to be at most $$0.1$$ wide.
